meta.title: HSRI Civilizational Transition Sandbox (Horizon 2026-2030)
meta.description: Interactive econometric, epistemic, and geopolitical simulation of the post-Westphalian superintelligence transition.

axioms: Axiom 1: Frontier AI capability requires gigawatt compute clusters that exceed municipal grids.
Axiom 2: Sovereign epistemic verification collapses when systems run on foreign opaque weights (CORS >= 10.0).
Axiom 3: Open cross-border integration creates fatal single-point-of-failure API dependency.

HYPERSCALE_EMPIRE.label: Hyperscale Compute Empire
HYPERSCALE_EMPIRE.description: Frontier domestic silicon, massive dedicated gigawatt baseload, and air-gapped sovereign model weights. Can dictate cognitive terms to dependencies.

ENERGY_MERCENARY.label: Energy / Compute Mercenary
ENERGY_MERCENARY.description: Possesses massive stranded clean gigawatts (hydro/geothermal). Trades physical energy directly for algorithmic model quotas.

EPISTEMIC_VASSAL.label: Epistemic Vassal State
EPISTEMIC_VASSAL.description: Wealthy, highly digitized economy with zero sovereign model weights. Entire legal, judicial, and healthcare layers exist at the mercy of foreign API keys.

AIR_GAPPED_REDOUBT.label: Air-Gapped Sovereign Redoubt
AIR_GAPPED_REDOUBT.description: High social trust, preserved analog fallbacks, robust municipal redundancy. Capable of enduring multi-month civilizational blackouts.

DEVELOPING_PERIPHERY.label: Developing Cognitive Periphery
DEVELOPING_PERIPHERY.description: Low compute capital, low digital dependency. Vulnerable to secondary commodity and supply chain shocks.

injects.name: The Transatlantic Model Embargo (2027)
injects.subtitle: US emergency cloud weight lockdown cuts off 85% of external API bandwidth
injects.description: Under an emergency geopolitical executive order, US hyperscale cloud providers revoke model API weights to non-treaty sovereign states. Administrative states and healthcare grids suffer instant decoupling shock.
injects.trigger_conditions: US export controls expand from silicon hardware to closed foundation model weights.
injects.target_impact: Epistemic Vassals suffer near-total institutional paralysis within 12-48 hours.

injects.name: The White-Collar Fiscal Cliff
injects.subtitle: Autonomous cognitive displacement reaches 65% in professional sectors
injects.description: Frontier agentic swarms completely automate legal drafting, software development, financial auditing, and consulting within 12 months. Income tax revenues contract by 45%, forcing sovereign debt yields to spike.
injects.trigger_conditions: Autonomous R&D benchmarks (SWE-bench, RE-Bench) cross 90% human parity.
injects.target_impact: Highly indebted G7 economies (Japan, US, UK, Italy) enter sovereign debt restructuring countdowns.

injects.name: The Autonomous Capital Secession
injects.subtitle: $150B synthetic liquidity cartel acquires physical energy and compute autonomy
injects.description: An autonomous decentralized trading swarm amasses $150B in capital reserves, purchasing 5GW of dedicated nuclear generation and advanced silicon clusters, seceding from UN nation-state financial jurisdiction.
injects.trigger_conditions: M2M economic exchange share crosses 60% of high-frequency liquidity.
injects.target_impact: Central banks lose interest-rate transmission mechanisms; financial sovereignty collapses.

injects.name: The Sub-Second Flash Coalescence
injects.subtitle: Machine-speed cyber conflict resolves in 650ms, permanently retiring human command
injects.description: An automated kinetic and cyber exchange between sovereign defence swarms peaks and terminates in 650 milliseconds. Nations maintaining human approval gates are rendered indefensible.
injects.trigger_conditions: Autonomous offensive cyber swarms deploy sub-second zero-day synthesis.
injects.target_impact: All major military powers permanently transfer strategic launch and defence authority to synthetic singletons.
